body: Bitwise or with logical negation, I'm not sure what that would do, is it meant to be bitwise negation `~`?

It is binary, this part is DOS attribute: if `w` is not set, set last bit (read-only flag), this code is copy-pasted from some other ZIP handler and already used in multiple cases. `bool` to `int` always expands to `1` or `0`, so logic here seems fine. But might be worth to make more readable.
Should probably be looked at as it makes it either add `1` or `0` depending on if `_mode & 0200` is zero or not, would be good to verify it actually does what it should

Indeed it should probably be:
```suggestion
	zipfi.external_fa = (_mode << 16L) | ((_mode & 0200) ? 0 : 1);
```
